parameters.formTitle: DTJ store brief: your brand and product facts
parameters.formDescription: This tells us what your product page may say. Only write facts you can back up, for example from your pack, your product description or your own records. Nothing goes on your store until a DTJ person has checked it with you.

values.placeholder: yourbrand.myshopify.com
Optional: the number of the draft theme copy, or its editor link (DTJ can add it later)
#0B4A6F
#FFFFFF
#0F2A3A
https://... (a link to your logo file)
https://yourbrand.myshopify.com/products/...

One picture link per line. Optional label first, e.g.
pack | https://.../front.jpg
https://.../lifestyle.jpg

values.html:
3. What the page may say

One item per line. To say where a fact comes from, add it in [square brackets] at the end of the line, e.g. Acid-free [pack]. Lines without brackets use your answer to the next question. Leave anything you are not sure about empty: an empty answer leaves that part off the page. Please do not add reviews, ratings or claims you cannot show.

values.fieldLabel: Where do these facts come from?
values.placeholder: e.g. product description, pack, lab report

values.fieldLabel: Short tagline next to the price
values.placeholder: Up to 40 characters, e.g. Brush-free. No touch.

Up to 6, one per line, e.g.
No scrubbing needed
Safe for septic tanks [pack]

Up to 6, one per line: title | one short sentence, e.g.
Acid-free and safe | No toxic fumes.
e.g. Foam that actually works.
A few sentences about the product, up to 400 characters.

2 to 5 steps, one per line, e.g.
Drop the sachet in

Up to 6, one per line: value | label | note (optional), e.g.
400 g | Net weight [pack]

Up to 6, one per line: item | detail (optional), e.g.

Up to 12, one per line, e.g.

Up to 12, one per line: question | answer, e.g.

Real reviews only, up to 8, one per line: stars 1-5 | name, city | what they wrote [where it was posted], e.g.
5 | Priya, Pune | Works really well [Judge.me]
Only if real, e.g. 4.6 [Judge.me]

Up to 4, one per line, e.g.

3 to 10 rows, one per line: us | them, e.g.

parameters.completionTitle: Thank you, we have your brief

parameters.content:
## Client brief intake (shadow: collects only)
Collects a client's real brand and product facts for the page builder. Nothing here touches a store.

- Every answer is saved in the data table **dtj_client_intake** with status `new` or `needs-fixes`; the raw answer is kept.
- A brief saved as `new` starts **Store Factory: Page Design** (without waiting), which hands the design to Claude Code; the client still sees the thank-you page straight away.
- The code node's source and its tests live in git at `n8n/client-intake/`. Change it there first, then here.
